svg.title: A global deadline for fossil fuels?
svg.desc: Two perspectives with ten picks each. Differ Impact is the weighted score out of 100. Differ Rank orders all twenty arguments from highest to lowest impact. Exact ties use the earlier pick, then the permanent argument ID.
svg.text: A global deadline for fossil fuels?
Should countries agree on a deadline to phase out fossil fuels?

g.title: Investment timetable — Give utilities a date for new equipment.
g.text: Give utilities a date for new equipment.

g.title: Electricity access — Leave time to connect more homes.
g.text: Leave time to connect more homes.

g.title: Earlier emissions cuts — A deadline could accelerate cuts.
Reliable power — Add supply and lines before retiring plants.
g.text: Add supply and lines before retiring plants.

g.text: Compare progress and spot funding gaps.

g.title: Cost of borrowing — High financing costs limit options.
Supply chains — Help equipment makers anticipate demand.

g.title: Worker transitions — Plan training before local jobs change.
g.text: Plan training before local jobs change.

g.title: Finance in hand — Match commitments to available funds.

svg.text: Differ Impact = 50% magnitude + 30% reach + 20% duration. Highest impact ranks first.
